email.body:
NOON REPORT - MV TORMAR SPRING
Date/time: 26 Jan 2025 1200 (ship's time UTC)
Position: 50-50.2N 031-32.2W
Distance run last 24h: 231.3 nm
Average speed last 24h: 12.5 kn
ROB VLSFO: 1019.0 t
ROB MGO: 94.5 t
Consumption last 24h: VLSFO 18.8 t, MGO 0.1 t
Next port: Sept-Iles
ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-31 1100 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Main engine stopped 0610-1140 UTC on charterers' instructions: vessel drifting awaiting voyage orders. Orders received 1140, passage resumed. Average speed over 18.5 h steaming. Fuel used during stoppage: VLSFO 1.1 t (generators and boiler).

Master MV TORMAR SPRING
